House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Veterans and Military Affairs Division

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to veterans; appropriating money for a grant to Fishing with Vets; requiring reports.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; FISHING WITH VETS. +]

[+$25,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $25,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of veterans affairs for a grant to Fishing with Vets, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to organize and conduct guided fishing trips for veterans across Minnesota. By January 15 each year, the commissioner of veterans affairs must report to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees with jurisdiction over veterans regarding the uses of grant money, including any amount used for grant administration. The report must be filed with the Legislative Reference Library in compliance with Minnesota Statutes, section 3.195. As a condition of receiving the grant, Fishing with Vets must agree to provide the commissioner of veterans affairs any information needed to complete the report. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to veterans; appropriating money for a grant to Fishing with Vets; requiring reports.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; FISHING WITH VETS.

$25,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $25,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of veterans affairs for a grant to Fishing with Vets, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to organize and conduct guided fishing trips for veterans across Minnesota. By January 15 each year, the commissioner of veterans affairs must report to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees with jurisdiction over veterans regarding the uses of grant money, including any amount used for grant administration. The report must be filed with the Legislative Reference Library in compliance with Minnesota Statutes, section 3.195. As a condition of receiving the grant, Fishing with Vets must agree to provide the commissioner of veterans affairs any information needed to complete the report.
additions: $25,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $25,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of veterans affairs for a grant to Fishing with Vets, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to organize and conduct guided fishing trips for veterans across Minnesota. By January 15 each year, the commissioner of veterans affairs must report to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees with jurisdiction over veterans regarding the uses of grant money, including any amount used for grant administration. The report must be filed with the Legislative Reference Library in compliance with Minnesota Statutes, section 3.195. As a condition of receiving the grant, Fishing with Vets must agree to provide the commissioner of veterans affairs any information needed to complete the report.
